review_scope: Explicit implementation-custody mapping of bounded local repository evidence; not requirement acceptance or independent review.

entries.rationale: The mapped evidence-chain implementation and tamper tests provide local trace links for proposal-to-terminal chain construction and verification.
entries.trust_boundary: Evidence writers are inside implementation custody; the offline verifier and retained package are local artifacts without independent custody.
entries.configuration: Deterministic local evidence-chain fixtures and the retained M4b manifest.
entries.environment: Local software test and simulated-OT evidence package; no independent evidence custodian.
entries.limitations: The mapping does not demonstrate every proposal path, external anchoring, independent custody, or requirement acceptance.

entries.rationale: The M4b package writer, offline-verifier tests, and retained manifest provide bounded local evidence for artifact inventory and source/package integrity fields.
entries.trust_boundary: Package generation and verification remain within implementation custody; the external trust anchor is a local research artifact.
entries.configuration: Committed M4b evidence package with manifest, schemas, source snapshot, topology, scenarios, and integrity records.
entries.environment: Local simulated-OT campaign package; not a production build, independent reproduction, or external qualification record.
entries.limitations: The retained M4b package does not by itself cover every end-state binding category or establish independent provenance.

entries.rationale: The gateway implementation and focused tests map the local permit-admission sequence across identity, freshness, replay, approval, and safety checks.
entries.trust_boundary: The local gateway is outside the proposing-agent object but remains in the same implementation and test custody.
entries.configuration: Default deterministic local lab configuration with signed identities, delegation, policy, replay state, and safety kernel.
entries.environment: Local software conformance fixtures; no representative multi-host or HIL acceptance environment.
entries.limitations: Mapped tests cover selected local paths and do not establish complete end-state channel, deployment, or independent acceptance evidence.

entries.rationale: The deterministic fleet model explicitly exercises the four named logical-agent scales and an explicit provisional action/conflict mix.
entries.trust_boundary: The fleet workload generator and verifier share implementation custody and produce modeled, not representative operational, evidence.
entries.configuration: Fixed deterministic M6 v2 model assumptions for 10, 100, 1,000, and 10,000 logical agents.
entries.environment: Deterministic analytical model on a local Python runtime; no distributed workload or approved representative mix.
entries.limitations: The action/conflict distribution is explicitly provisional and unapproved, and the run is a model rather than a representative distributed fleet test.

entries.rationale: The fleet model emits the named delegation, approval, replay, pending-effect, reconciliation, policy-distribution, and operator-span measures.
entries.trust_boundary: All modeled measures and their checks remain within implementation custody and depend on declared analytical assumptions.
entries.configuration: Fixed deterministic M6 v2 fleet model with explicit units, queue assumptions, and measurement definitions.
entries.environment: Deterministic analytical model on a local Python runtime; no measured distributed infrastructure.
entries.limitations: The measures are modeled outputs, not observed fleet performance, representative capacity evidence, or verification completion.

entries.rationale: The deterministic safety kernel and independently implemented decimal oracle tests map selected unsafe-transition denial behavior.
entries.trust_boundary: The safety kernel is outside the proposing agent, while both the kernel and reference oracle remain under implementation custody.
entries.configuration: Deterministic local safety parameters and decimal reference-oracle fixtures.
entries.environment: Synthetic local safety model; no approved site envelope, HIL plant, or independent assessor.
entries.limitations: The mapped evidence is synthetic and local and does not prove an approved operational constraint set, physical accuracy, or independent validation.
